images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: a single complete botanical leaf cutout for a printed design textbook, text must wrap around its actual silhouette. The attached photograph is a reference for the green veining and material only, not an edit target to keep rectangular. Recreate one entire broad lanceolate tropical leaf, viewed almost straight-on, with a natural central rib and fine parallel diagonal veins like the reference. Show a complete pointed tip, all side edges, and a short petiole; the leaf should lean subtly diagonally from lower left to upper right. Photorealistic botanical specimen with clear rich green venation, realistic fine texture, soft diffuse light, crisp edges, nearly all in focus. Natural green hues and slightly lighter veins. One single leaf only. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the leaf, no pot, no scene, no label, no frame, no typography. Center the whole object within the canvas with roughly 5-8% transparent safety around its silhouette. Do not crop the leaf, do not create a rectangular macro crop, do not add other plants. High-resolution specimen photograph.
images.cleanup_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit only the background of the attached complete leaf image. Preserve the exact green leaf, its full pointed tip, short petiole, internal veining, color, sharpness, position and photographic realism. Remove ALL blurred green haze, glow and dark background outside the actual leaf edge; these are background, not part of the leaf. All pixels outside the crisp anatomical leaf outline and petiole must become completely transparent alpha 0, including all four corners and the area next to the tip. The opaque leaf surface should remain fully opaque alpha 255. No glow, no outer shadow, no scenery, no checkerboard painted into the image. Genuine transparent background. Do not crop, reshape, rotate, redraw or change the leaf. Keep the entire object and transparent safety margin.
